value.rationale: The ideal-power operation is the subject of 2026 primary research; the first ordinary numerical semigroup of embedding dimension three is the natural next case beyond its complete two-generator formula. The theorem completely classifies additive minimal generators at every power, replacing a quadratic raw-product candidate list by an exactly linear 2k+1 basis. The calculation identifies the special relation and rigorous arithmetic obstruction, without claiming downstream generalizations.
